Our Story

Built on Experience. Driven by Purpose. Committed to Sustainable Businesses.

Established in 2019, Gubela Holdings supports the development of capable, compliant and sustainable businesses. Our foundation draws on more than two decades of experience in transformation, enterprise and supplier development, governance, operations and strategic leadership.

Our founder’s entrepreneurial journey and work alongside SMMEs across industries reveal common obstacles: funding readiness and cash flow; compliance and governance; inadequate operational and financial systems; limited market access; and gaps in management and technical capacity.

We believe lasting progress goes beyond training or access to funding. Gubela connects practical diagnostics, coaching, mentorship, specialist expertise and implementation support—helping enterprises strengthen accountability, build capability and pursue sustainable growth.

We exist to build businesses that build people.

FOUNDER & LEADERSHIP

Experience that connects strategy with business reality.

Zanele Njova | FOUNDER & Lead Business Transformation Advisor. Her professional experience spans enterprise and supplier development, operations, business transformation and leadership across state-owned enterprises, defence, petroleum, construction, manufacturing and other sectors.

Her perspective combines corporate expectations of suppliers with the day-to-day pressures entrepreneurs face. This informs Gubela’s hands-on, commercially grounded support.

Our promise: practical guidance, clear accountability and measurable business improvement.

We exist to build businesses that build people.

The Gubela Approach

A structured journey, tailored to each enterprise.

ASSESS → DIAGNOSE → STRATEGISE → IMPLEMENT → MONITOR → SUSTAIN

We start by understanding the business and identifying its priorities. We then agree a practical development plan, match appropriate advisory or specialist support, and monitor progress against defined outcomes.

A paid consultation establishes fit; diagnostics, coaching, mentorship, advisory and implementation are separately scoped and quoted. This is aligned with our Advisory Services & Pricing Catalogue.

We exist to build businesses that build people.

BUILD | Start-up SMMEs — founder coaching, business foundations, planning, customers and basic financial discipline.

SMME Development Centre

Connecting business needs, specialist expertise and opportunity.

Gubela is developing an integrated SMME Development Centre to coordinate diagnostics, development plans, coaching, mentorship, specialist interventions and performance monitoring.

We are building a vetted network of facilitators, assessors, coaches, mentors and technical specialists. Gubela aims to open doors for these professionals by engaging corporates, SETAs, skills providers and development institutions with appropriately structured solutions.

Our services include funding readiness (not funding guarantees), governance, compliance, business systems, operational capability, leadership and supplier development. Gubela leads programme design, client engagement and quality oversight; specialists deliver clearly agreed assignments.

We exist to build businesses that build people.
